variant.author: nainaiowo
variant.changelog: New scenes save camera and light placement relative to the GPose target character, so setups follow its position and facing across locations. Older scenes retain absolute placement and need resaving in their original setup. Added previous/next camera buttons and Unlock view for moving a preview without changing saved cameras. Camera paths can return smoothly to their first key with a saved return duration. Relative/world path switches now convert coordinates instead of moving the view. Replaced the redundant saved-file edit action with deletion requiring Ctrl+Shift. Light deletion now handles unavailable captures and unapplied drafts, retires illumination before cleanup, and removes deleted editor state. Audited schemas, native input isolation, Undo/Redo and GPose cleanup.

variant.changelog: Camera previews retain their names with an unlocked preview suffix and remember movement when switching views or returning from Game camera. Scene placement remains character-relative by default; the separate camera-path placement option is unchanged.

variant.author: nainaiowo
variant.changelog: Cleaner Actors and Pose tools. Create actor copies the selected actor; redundant actor/session and frozen-actor panels are removed. Pose uses a compact editor and a separate Figure/List picker with original curved body parts. Figure parts independently toggle visible bone regions, including fingers and toes, and remain effective while browsing List/search. Hidden regions also hide their handles; hiding settles live edits first and preserves recovery on failure. Visibility starts empty and resets on GPose exit. Mirror now clearly identifies its List category scope. Load/Save and Advanced controls are easier to reach.

variant.author: nainaiowo
variant.changelog: Bone dots and posing handles now share the rendered model's full position, quaternion rotation and scale, including both model scale factors. Custom body scaling and tilted or moved models no longer use stale actor coordinates. Dots, bone lines and click targets project directly each frame without pixel holding or smoothing lag. Missing or invalid rendered transforms hide the overlay and stop its handle safely instead of guessing a position.
